description.value: Bella Roma Pizzeria & Ristorante is a locally owned Italian restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, helmed by chef Jimmy Khinda who trained for three years in Italy before bringing his craft home to BC. The menu centres on pizza and pasta, with customer reviews highlighting generous portions and fresh seafood dishes. A patio at the back of the restaurant provides an outdoor seating option.
